localChanges: A civilisation that comes back in a game with no human player now starts with some of what the other civilisations commonly know, as one does when you play: before, it came back knowing nothing however late the game was (#609).

log: `player/defeated/respawn` gave a returning civilization, at 50% each, the advances the human knows that another civilization also knows. With no human seat (civ-clone/web-renderer#606) that set was empty, so it came back with nothing however late the game was. `lib/inheritedAdvances` now decides: the human's rule when a person plays, and otherwise every advance at least two civilizations know, which is what the human's rule means by common knowledge (civ-clone/web-renderer#609).
